name: Costly Menace
summary: In Southshore, Darren Malvew fears the mountain lions coming down from Alterac. Undead, the Syndicate gang, and other scoundrels have cost the town horses, but Darren says the lions are the greatest threat.

sections.title: Horses Lost
sections.body: Darren Malvew of Southshore cannot bear losing the town's beautiful horses. Undead, the Syndicate gang, and scoundrels in the region have already cost the town quite a few. Darren says the greatest danger comes from mountain lions in Alterac, which keep descending from the hills.

sections.title: Lions of the Hills
sections.body: Darren wants eight Mountain Lions and ten Hulking Mountain Lions dealt with. Mountain Lions are found in the lower hills of the Alterac Mountains.

faq.answer: Darren Malvew lives in Southshore, in Hillsbrad Foothills, and is tired of losing the town's horses.

faq.q: Where are the mountain lions coming from?
faq.answer: The mountain lions come down from the hills of Alterac. Mountain Lions are found in the lower hills of the Alterac Mountains.

faq.q: What threats to the horses does Darren mention?
faq.answer: Undead, the Syndicate gang, and other scoundrels in the region have cost Southshore horses, but Darren says the mountain lions of Alterac are the greatest threat.

faq.q: What specific beasts need to be culled?
faq.answer: Eight Mountain Lions and ten Hulking Mountain Lions.
